spec.goal: Ensure GET /tasks/:id returns HTTP 404 with body {"error":"task_not_found"} when the requested task does not exist, without changing unrelated behavior.
requirements: For a GET request whose path matches /tasks/:id, call the task service lookup and return status 404 with exactly { error: "task_not_found" } when no task is found.
For an existing task, preserve the current successful GET behavior and response.
Preserve all other task routes and behaviors, including the generic 404 response for unmatched routes.
constraints: Use the existing HttpResponse shape and TaskService lookup behavior.
Keep the change scoped to the GET task-by-ID behavior; do not alter service data or unrelated route semantics.

The repository currently contains the requested behavior in getTask and an existing test covering the missing-task response, so implementation should preserve that contract rather than introduce a different error format.
nonGoals: Changing POST /tasks, GET /tasks collection filtering, complete/reopen behavior, or unmatched-route handling.
Changing the test suite or adding unrelated API behavior.
acceptance: GET /tasks/missing (or any nonexistent task ID) responds with status 404.
The response body is exactly { error: "task_not_found" }.
GET /tasks/:id for an existing task remains status 200 with that task.
Existing unrelated tests and route behavior remain unchanged.
verification: Run the repository test script: npm test.
Confirm the existing GET /tasks/:id missing-task test passes, including both status and exact body assertions.
Confirm the existing-task and unrelated task route tests continue to pass.
